senses.definition: The pipes, together with the joints, tanks, stopcocks, taps, and other fixtures of a water, gas, or sewage system in a house or other building.
examples: Water was dripping from the ceiling, so we figured there was a problem with the plumbing.

senses.definition: The trade or occupation of a plumber.
(informal) A system of vessels or ducts in the human body, especially the genitourinary system.
examples: My plumbing was playing up, so I had to see the doctor.

quotes.text: I am sure that there are those who dislike me […] but as a person, not for the sake of my plumbing.

senses.definition: (informal, figurative) Practical, concrete work serving to support other work.
examples: This is not scientific research as such: it's just plumbing.

senses.definition: (countable) A Murasugi sum where each disk summed along has its boundary subdivided into four segments.
